description: Authored synthetic retrieval checks. Not held-out production accuracy.

documents.refund: Refunds are credited to the original payment method within five business days after approval.
documents.supervisor: When a caller requests a manager or supervisor, offer a transfer to a human escalation specialist.
documents.delivery: Order tracking provides the parcel location, shipping carrier and estimated delivery date.
documents.card: Never ask callers to speak their complete bank card number, security code or online banking password.
documents.cancel: Customers can cancel their subscription to stop automatic renewal and future monthly charges.
documents.discount: Promotional coupons and discount codes apply only when currently listed in the approved offer catalog.
documents.hours: Human customer support is open Monday to Friday from nine in the morning until six in the evening, and closed on weekends.
documents.returns: Damaged products can be returned within thirty days with proof of purchase for inspection.
